confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded from several aggregator and blog estimates (Numbeo-derived figures, Nomad Ranker, ExpatExchange, Magic Towns, Where and When, Travel Tables) that disagree widely, and some are dated (Travel Tables was last updated July 2023). July is peak season, so a seasonal seafront premium is included. Lek conversions use roughly 85 lek per USD. Cocktail and wine anchors come from Saranda guide ranges, not from direct price checks. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from searches or live listings, and are the least certain. FX: the 0.6720 value for 2026-11-18 comes from a secondary report of the RBA 4pm rate. I did not open the rba.gov.au table to confirm it, though market quotes around that date (about 0.6715 to 0.6732) are consistent with it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Saranda is treated as a coastal Albanian resort priced above the national average (MyLifeElsewhere places it about 26% above Albania overall). Beverage anchors reference Saranda guide ranges and Tirana draft and cappuccino prices, with a summer tourist premium applied. Accommodation is a holistic judgement of peak-season seaside resort levels in Albania.
